name: AiApiKey
title: Blocks/Ai/AiApiKey
summary: Bring your own key: the reader picks a model provider in a `Select`, pastes a key in a masked `PasswordInput` (never prefilled, cleared once saved) and saves it; a status row shows whether a key is saved (only its masked tail) and the result of Test connection, a failure shows in an `Alert`, and Remove key asks in a `ConfirmDialog`. The block stores nothing: it emits save, test and remove for the app's key store (TanStack AI's `useByok`). Built from `PageHeader`, `Subheader`, `Card`, `Item`, `SettingsRow`, `Select`, `PasswordInput`, `FieldError`, `StatusIndicator`, `Alert`, `Button` and `ConfirmDialog`. A page body for ConsoleLayout.
intents: usar minha própria chave de api
chave de api do provedor de ia
usar mi propia clave de api

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No key saved: only Save key shows.

variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: The save is in flight: the controls lock and Save key spins, keeping focus.

variants.name: Testing
variants.summary: Test connection runs: the status reads Testing, Remove key and the Provider lock.

variants.name: Success
variants.summary: The test passed: the status reads Connected.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The test failed: the status reads Connection failed and an Alert gives the reason with Test again.

variants.name: SaveError
variants.summary: The save failed: an Alert gives the reason with no action; Save key retries.
